propositions: Fourteen call sites in src/rebar/llm hand-build identical single-turn structured requests (mode='structured' + execution_mode='single_turn' + output_schema), violating RunRequest's contract that these stay consistent and creating maintainability debt.

Bounding decisions (output_token_limit, structured_retry_limit, transport_attempt_limit, request_timeout_limit_s) are invisible and mostly omitted: only judge_batch declares bounds and only completion_recovery.py sets a token cap, making unbounded sites indistinguishable from deliberately-unbounded ones.

A shared builder with required bounds argument must replace the fourteen hand-built sites, making the bounding decision mandatory and visible via a single greppable token (bounds=RunRequest.INHERIT_POLICY or explicit values).

Guard test (AST match over src/rebar excluding runner.py) must enforce that direct RunRequest(...) carrying both execution_mode='single_turn' and mode='structured' does not appear without a reasoned '# single-turn-structured-ok: <reason>' marker.
